items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: On the steamer St. Paul, we had Stuff Smith and Swazey.

ctx.x: Is this where you picked up Stuff or before you came to St. Louis?
Before we came into St. Louis, we picked up Stuff and then Swazey came
in the band. Swazey came back to the band?
